items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to issuing non-driver
identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3809

SPONSOR: SKOUFIS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to issuing
non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driv-
ing privileges

 
PURPOSE:

To require the Department of Motor Vehicles to issue a non-driver iden-
tification card to an individual who has had their driver's license
suspended by a court.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Requires the Department of Motor Vehicles, when a court
suspends a driver's license, to immediately issue to the person whose
driver's license was suspended a non-driver identification photo card to
such person. The nondriver identification card shall be in the same form
as any other non-driver identification card issue under section 490 of
the vehicle and traffic law.

Section 2: Effective date

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill will direct the Department of Motor Vehicles to provide those
individuals with a court ordered suspension of a driver's license with a
nondriver identification photo card. The issuance of a non-driver's
identification card will allow those with a suspended driver's license
to complete necessary daily functions such as travelling, banking, and
shopping.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the ninetieth day after it shall have
become a law. Effective immediately, the addition, amendment and/or
repeal of any rule or regulation necessary for the implementation of 13
this act on its effective date are authorized to be made and completed
14 on or before such effective date.

summary: Issues non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges due to a driving while intoxicated arrest.
